segments.title: TITLE
segments.vo: This is Skew. An autonomous options desk that never predicts where the market is going.

segments.title: THE PROBLEM
segments.vo: The usual way to trade options is to forecast direction, then buy one pointing at the guess. That treats an option as leveraged stock. It is a bet on a forecast nobody can reliably make.

segments.title: FOUR CAPABILITIES
segments.vo: Skew measures four things instead. The price of movement. Its reality. The stress grid. And limits the desk must earn.

segments.title: THE SIGNAL
segments.vo_template: Eight names, scanned every five minutes against live Alpaca chains. On this name implied volatility is running at {iv_words} while realized sits at {rv_words}. The market is overcharging by {vrp_words} points, and that gap is the entire signal.
segments.vo: Eight names, scanned every five minutes against live Alpaca chains. On this name implied volatility is running at twenty four point three while realized sits at eighteen. The market is overcharging by six point three points, and that gap is the entire signal.

segments.title: CONSTRUCTION
segments.vo: Volatility is rich, so the desk sells premium. It builds defined risk structures sized backwards from the budget, so it never proposes a trade it is not permitted to take. Maximum loss is computed before the position exists.

segments.title: THE GATES
segments.vo: Five deterministic gates run before the model is asked anything. Liquidity, earnings, term structure, stress, and budget. Every result is recorded, pass or fail.

vo_parts.text_template: Here is the one that matters. Every candidate is repriced across eighty four stress scenarios. Price shocks to three standard deviations, implied volatility doubling, at three points in time. On this trade, one ordinary move already consumes {consumed_words} percent of its maximum loss. The limit is {limit_words}.

segments.title: RESTRAINT
segments.vo_template: Across this account the desk has looked at {looked_words} opportunities and declined almost all of them. It has filled {acted_words}. Restraint is the default, not the exception.

segments.title: THE CORRECTION
segments.vo_template: On the second of September the desk caught its own record diverging from the broker, reconciled, and wrote {corr_words} corrections into the record. They are still there. A log that cannot disagree with you is not a log.

segments.title: EXECUTION
segments.vo: A structure that clears every gate executes as a single atomic multi leg order. Four legs, one order, straight into a hundred thousand dollar paper account.

segments.title: AUTHORITY
segments.vo: The desk starts at half a percent of equity per position and earns larger limits only by closing trades without a breach. Size is a privilege, not a default.

segments.title: MCP
segments.vo: The whole desk is exposed over MCP. Seven read tools always on, two write tools that are not even registered unless explicitly enabled. The model can choose among approved structures. It cannot invent one.

segments.title: TRACE
segments.vo: Every decision is reconstructible to its inputs. Including the ones it refused.

segments.title: CLOSE
segments.vo: Skew, by team Zevora. It does not predict the market. It prices it.
